decisions: Namespace qualification selects an exact function name but does not assert a self receiver.
Only a declared self input checks the exact inherent receiver before specialization; ordinary generic globals defer to existing declared-input specialization.
SLG typed method selection already requires an impl parent and actual declared receiver, separately from imported/global name resolution. Qualify current execution before changing that distinction.
Retain original C426 wrong-owner, wrong declared role and wrong callback-result rejection.
